purpose: R1-P backdoor scan classification. Vendor globals are excluded by an explicit key allowlist in preview_verify.py; the generic `window.__` prefix is NEVER whitelisted. Every project-owned runtime global must appear here with its gate and an explicit statement of whether it can influence the public economic contract. An unlisted project-owned global, or any entry with can_force_economic_state=true, fails the scan.

globals.note: Previously installed unconditionally; hardened in this round because seeding the query cache could have forced a `ready` projection status.
